episode_state_semantics.ELIGIBLE: technically valid protocol reached eligible population but final qualification/metric state not represented by QUALIFIED label
episode_state_semantics.PROTOCOL_REACHED_NOT_ELIGIBLE: all technical/protocol stages valid but frozen scientific eligibility/qualification gate yields no eligible/qualified measurement population as prospectively defined; scientific_metric_evaluated must still mean the preregistered terminal eligibility gate itself was validly evaluated
episode_state_semantics.QUALIFIED: technically valid run reaches all preregistered scientific measurement/gate stages
episode_state_semantics.TECHNICAL_ERROR: any runtime/provenance/serialization/capture/publication exception before a valid frozen terminal gate

record_order: research_execution_attest recorded from immutable runner attestation artifact
only then brain_result_assess if attestation technical_valid=true and measurement_reached=true

stage_semantics.environment_actions_executed: nonnegative total executed study-environment actions, recorded mechanically, not used as scientific effect metric
stage_semantics.environment_reset: for every attempted fixed study family, ALFWorld reset returned without technical exception
stage_semantics.executor_started: frozen executor stage was reached where protocol requires it; family-level planner rejection is handled by runner aggregate logic, not by pretending executor ran
stage_semantics.initial_observation_received: for every attempted fixed study family, nonempty live initial observation was received before planner call
stage_semantics.plan_parsed: frozen plan parser/acceptance stage was executed; false plan acceptance for a family may be a scientific non-eligibility only if parser itself had no technical error
stage_semantics.planner_called: frozen one-attempt planner stage was actually reached for every attempted family (planner rejection is scientific protocol outcome only after call completes technically)
stage_semantics.runtime_initialized: exact reviewed Python/CUDA/model/runtime hashes validated before study execution
stage_semantics.scientific_eligibility_evaluated: all32 fixed attempts and two-stage frozen eligibility/qualification logic completed without technical exception; no replacement/rescue
stage_semantics.scientific_metric_evaluated: a preregistered terminal scientific gate was validly computed: either <16 final-qualified => frozen INCONCLUSIVE eligibility gate, or >=16 => full representation metrics/gates. Technical failures must never set this true.

future_run_attestation.technical_errors_rule: Any technical error object requires exact stage/type/message. Any study-family runtime exception before the valid frozen terminal gate forces technical_status=FAIL, episode_state=TECHNICAL_ERROR, scientific_metric_evaluated=false.
future_run_attestation.technical_status: PASS only for scientifically interpretable terminal run; otherwise FAIL

correct_attestation_under_this_contract.technical_error_signature: environment_reset / NameError / name r is not defined

invalid_v21_counterfactual.effect: Brain scientific assessment would have been refused before the false INCONCLUSIVE transition.

launcher_preflight.allowed_target: prospectively frozen non-study ALFWorld train task-family game OR synthetic TextWorld grammar canary
launcher_preflight.failure_policy: abort before study cohort; no Experiment scientific measurement; record technical failure only
launcher_preflight.note: Do not use Research OS RuntimeCanary for this reset-only preflight because native RuntimeCanary requires all eight execution stages.

prohibitions: no attestation inferred solely from exit code
no PASS attestation with partial stages
no T1/T1R unlock from technical attestation

server_contract.brain_guard: brain_result_assess refuses scientific outcome when execution_attestation technical_valid=false OR measurement_reached=false
server_contract.pass_rule: PASS requires every required stage true and zero technical_errors
server_contract.single_write_rule: research_execution_attest must be recorded once before result inspection; later conflicting attestation is rejected
